name: Laughing
overview: Scripture presents laughing as a complex expression that can signify joy and divine blessing, as seen in Sarah's laughter of disbelief and then joy when God fulfills His promise (Genesis 18:12; 21:6), and in the joyful rejoicing God grants His people (Job 8:21). At the same time, the Lord's laughter is portrayed as sovereign derision toward the wicked who oppose His righteous purposes (Psalms 2:4; 59:8), highlighting His supreme authority over all. Thus, biblical laughter encompasses both human delight in God's faithfulness and God's triumphant judgment over evil.
